scope: scripts/record-stabilization-evidence.mjs and tests/unit/stabilization-evidence.test.ts; no browser or heavy test run by this reviewer
accepted_source_properties: Guard and result SHA-256 values are computed from independently read file bytes rather than caller-supplied digests; the two source paths must resolve to distinct files.
The guard parser requires exactly one RESOURCE_ADMITTED and one RESOURCE_JOB_EXIT with the requested run ID, rejecting the observed Debug 006 log when asked to record Screenshot 001.
The writer uses exclusive create with mode 0600 and cannot overwrite an existing receipt or either source file.
Raw child stdout and arbitrary result fields are not copied into the record; the test independently recomputes both digests and checks private fixture strings are absent.

blocking_findings.problem: An admitted run with RESOURCE_JOB_EXIT childExitCode 0 is accepted even if the wrapper subsequently emits RESOURCE_OWNED_PROCESS_STILL_RUNNING or RESOURCE_GROUP_STILL_RUNNING for the same run. stabilization-resource.mjs sets wrapper exit code 3 on those post-child cleanup failures, so the generated summary can look successful despite failed resource ownership. The guard parser only validates the admitted and child-exit pair; it does not classify terminal wrapper failure events.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Refuse guard logs containing terminal unsafe/cleanup failure events and add a test with RESOURCE_ADMITTED, child exit 0, then RESOURCE_OWNED_PROCESS_STILL_RUNNING for the same run. Do not promote a child result to overall run success when wrapper completion is unproven.

blocking_findings.problem: The result status is copied independently of the guard exit. A child exit code 1 paired with a raw result status of pass remains raw_result.status=pass, with no classified inconsistency or failure verdict. The current tests cover only exit 0 with partial status.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Explicitly classify or reject nonzero-child/pass inconsistencies and test that failure cannot be represented as an accepted pass. Preserve the raw status only as an attributed observation if needed.

bounded_metadata_note: The fixed output shape excludes private payload fields. Source path strings and accepted version strings are not length-bounded, so callers should pass only intended evidence paths; a bounded-path/version check would make this guarantee stronger without copying raw payload.
next_step: Repair the two guard-status cases, obtain a fresh source review and root-owned guarded unit run, then generate a separate Screenshot 001 correction without modifying the original receipt.
